method: Re-run the complete preserved lesson verifier and inspect current Anthropic prompt-guidance, SDK and stop-reason sources. Compile and exercise the full Python sample through fake responses. Render and inspect the production page in light/dark themes. No provider call or historical run replay.

observations.trace: Historical prompt samples stay explicitly unreproducible. The 150-character constraint confounds output-length comparison; keyword candidate labels require manual adjudication, and host logic retains hard policy enforcement.

limitations: Historical per-call prompts/responses, exact endpoint/model fingerprint, sampling parameters, task mapping and scorer are unavailable; historic counts cannot be independently recomputed.
No live provider request, current model behavior, policy adherence rate, production authorization or historical replay was tested.
The fake SDK checks client and local control flow only; it does not prove prompt quality or semantic classification.
